Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Booking.name: Booking
Booking.comment:
A booking of a room (D103, step 5): a Reservation, which says only its
resource, its interval, its amount and its currency. The bundle adds its
status Workflow, its Holds on the room's time, its Payments and the
Timers deadline that expires a hold.

fields.name: holdsState
fields.description: The least advanced state of the items: none before any is asked, then pending, held, committed, released or returned. A rule hears it turn committed.

fields.name: holdsTotal
fields.description: The sum of the priced items' unit prices times their quantities, as { amount, currency }: an item without a price adds nothing, and with none priced it is { amount: 0, currency: null }. Null only when the priced items' currencies differ or the sum passes what a JSON number holds exactly.

fields.name: paymentsDue
fields.description: What the instance owes, in the currency's minor units. It does not change while an attempt is open. From Holds.total, it is 0 while the total cannot be read (an item pending, priced items in two currencies, or a sum past what an integer holds), and openPayment and require refuse with total_unknown then.

fields.name: paymentsAuthorized
fields.description: What the provider has authorized and not voided or captured.

fields.name: paymentsCaptured
fields.description: What the provider has captured.

fields.name: paymentsRefunded
fields.description: What the provider has refunded.

fields.name: paymentsOutstanding
fields.description: due less captured, never below 0.

fields.name: paymentsOverpaid
fields.description: What captures brought past what was due, such as a late capture of an attempt that failed while a newer one paid, which Payments asked back with a refund of it.

fields.name: paymentsCurrency
fields.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount.

fields.name: paymentsState
fields.description: unpaid, pending (an attempt is open), authorized, paid, partiallyRefunded or refunded. A rule hears it turn paid.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

BookingChange.name: BookingChange
BookingChange.comment: The writes of Booking's rows its behaviors hear, one message per write, whoever makes it, which a trigger of the table writes and a behavior worker runs (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Booking row written.

fields.name: write
fields.description: What the write did: insert, update or delete.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the write was made, in epoch milliseconds, by the database's clock.

fields.name: before
fields.description: The row's columns before the write, by column, as JSON; null for an insert.

fields.name: after
fields.description: The row's columns after the write, by column, as JSON; null for a delete.

BookingDeadline.name: BookingDeadline
BookingDeadline.comment: The deadlines Booking's behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Booking row the deadline is armed on.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that armed it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name, the use's own.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was armed to fall due, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the use armed it with, which its deadline hook reads.

BookingHoldsItems.name: BookingHoldsItems
BookingHoldsItems.comment: On a table, each item the claim has taken, keyed by its hold and index: the supply it names, what it asks, its state and the unit price the supply held it at, and the Workflow entry it was taken at. An item its fields ask that it has not taken is no row; the items field shows it pending.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The hold's name and the item's index, joined by /.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: supplySchema
fields.description: The supply's type.

fields.name: supplyId
fields.description: The supply's key.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The units of counted supply it asks.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When the time it asks starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When the time it asks ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: pending, held, committed, released or returned.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The unit price the supply held it at, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The unit price's currency.

fields.name: takenAt
fields.description: The Workflow's enteredAt at the take, which tells a later entry of a takeOn state from this one.

BookingPaymentsActions.name: BookingPaymentsActions
BookingPaymentsActions.comment: On a table, each thing the provider's adapter is to do for the row (create, capture, void, refund), keyed by its id, waiting until an event for it is recorded.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The action's id, act_ and a key the command makes, which the adapter sends its provider as an idempotency key.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's actions, from 1.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: create, capture, void or refund.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt it acts on.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: For a refund, the refund.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider it is for.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it moves, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: doneAt
fields.description: When an event for it was recorded; absent while it waits.

BookingPaymentsAttempts.name: BookingPaymentsAttempts
BookingPaymentsAttempts.comment: On a table, each payment attempt the row opened, keyed by its id: its provider and the provider's reference, its amount, currency and what was due when it opened, its status, what is authorized and captured of it, a card's brand and last four digits, and when it opened and last moved.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt's id, pay_ and a key the command makes, which the adapter sends its provider as an idempotency key.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's attempts, from 1.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key openPayment opened it under.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider it is at.

fields.name: providerRef
fields.description: The provider's reference, once the adapter reports it.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: due
fields.description: What was due when it opened.

fields.name: status
fields.description: open, requiresAction, processing, authorized, captured, failed or cancelled.

fields.name: authorized
fields.description: What the provider authorized of it.

fields.name: captured
fields.description: What the provider captured of it.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: A card's brand, for display.

fields.name: last4
fields.description: A card's last four digits, for display.

fields.name: returnUrl
fields.description: Where the provider sends the payer back.

fields.name: openedAt
fields.description: When it opened, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

BookingPaymentsEvents.name: BookingPaymentsEvents
BookingPaymentsEvents.comment: On a table, every provider event recorded, kept for the table as a whole and keyed by its provider and event id, so an event applies once per table and provider: the row it was recorded on, its normalised fields alone, and whether it moved anything. A delete of the row leaves it, so a redelivery is still a repeat.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The provider and the event id, joined by /.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider.

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: The provider's event id.

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the row it was recorded on.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What it reported.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Its amount, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the provider says it happened, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt it reported on.

fields.name: providerRef
fields.description: The provider's reference it named.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund it reported on.

fields.name: applied
fields.description: Whether it moved anything.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: At most ten string pairs the adapter passed on.

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: When it was recorded, in epoch milliseconds.

BookingPaymentsIssues.name: BookingPaymentsIssues
BookingPaymentsIssues.comment: On a refund row (refundOf), each refund it asked of the row it refunds, keyed by the refund's id: its key, amount and currency, its status as the provider settled it, and the Workflow entry it was asked at.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund's id, as the row it refunds recorded it.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's issues, from 1.

fields.name: ofSchema
fields.description: The type of the row it refunds.

fields.name: ofId
fields.description: The key of the row it refunds.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key it was asked under: the refund row's type and key and the issue's number.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: status
fields.description: requested, sent, succeeded or failed.

fields.name: refunded
fields.description: What the provider refunded.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: The Workflow's enteredAt when it was asked, which tells a later entry of an issueOn state from this one.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

BookingPaymentsRefunds.name: BookingPaymentsRefunds
BookingPaymentsRefunds.comment: On a table, each refund asked of the row, keyed by its id: the attempt it draws on, its amount and reason, its status and what was refunded, and the refund row that asked it, if one did.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund's id, rf_ and a key the command makes.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's refunds, from 1.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key it was asked under.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The captured attempt it draws on.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: That attempt's provider.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was asked.

fields.name: status
fields.description: requested, sent, succeeded or failed.

fields.name: refunded
fields.description: What the provider refunded.

fields.name: originSchema
fields.description: The type of the refund row that asked it, through refundFor.

fields.name: originId
fields.description: The key of the refund row that asked it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

BookingTimersDeadlines.name: BookingTimersDeadlines
BookingTimersDeadlines.comment: One row per deadline started on the row, keyed by the deadline's name: the time it starts from, the fact it started from, when it is due (null once until cancelled it), whether and when it fired, and what its then met.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name in the config.

fields.name: baseAt
fields.description: The time the deadline starts from, in epoch milliseconds: the create's, the status's entry's, or the field's.

fields.name: armedFrom
fields.description: The fact it started from, as text: the create's or the entry's time, or the field's value. A write that leaves it as it is arms nothing.

fields.name: dueAt
fields.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds; null once until cancelled it.

fields.name: fired
fields.description: Whether it fired.

fields.name: firedAt
fields.description: When it fired.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: What its then met when it fired: moved, skipped, vetoed or forbidden.

Room.name: Room
Room.comment:
A room whose time Calendar opens (D70): weekday hours in Europe/London,
one booking at a time, on a quarter-hour grid, of a quarter of an hour
to two hours. The resource a booking's Reservation holds.

RoomCalendarBookings.name: RoomCalendarBookings
RoomCalendarBookings.comment: On a table, the supply's record of each claim item that holds or held time of the row, keyed by the claim's type and key, the hold and the item's index: the interval it asked, its state, which a call moves only forward, so a call made again changes nothing, and when it last moved. A deleted claim's records retire under a key of their own, its committed time still booked, so a claim created again with its key holds afresh.

fields.name: room
fields.description: The Room row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: record
fields.description: The claim's type, its key, the hold and the item's index, joined by /; a retired record's has # and a key of its own after it.

fields.name: holderSchema
fields.description: The claim's type.

fields.name: holderId
fields.description: The claim's key.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name in the claim's Holds config.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When the time it asked starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When the time it asked ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: held, committed or released.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: A price the supply held it at; Calendar gives none.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The price's currency; Calendar gives none.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: retired
fields.description: Whether it is a deleted claim's.

RoomCalendarClosures.name: RoomCalendarClosures
RoomCalendarClosures.comment: On a table, the row's closures, keyed by their name, closure-1 onward: when each starts and ends, why, who made it and when.

fields.name: room
fields.description: The Room row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: closure
fields.description: The closure's name.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When it starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When it ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why, as the caller gave it.

fields.name: by
fields.description: The subject of the caller who made it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was made, in epoch milliseconds.

RoomCalendarSettings.name: RoomCalendarSettings
RoomCalendarSettings.comment: On a table, what setOpeningHours and addClosure set of the row, keyed by name: hours, the row's own weekly hours; timeZone, its own zone; closuresMade, how many closures it has made, which names the next. A name with no row follows the config.

fields.name: room
fields.description: The Room row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: hours, timeZone or closuresMade.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Its value: the hours by day, the zone's IANA name, or the count.
